executive_summary: Clarion Data Systems submitted a proposal that conceptually covers all seven medium-priority requirements outlined in NordFrame Logistics' evaluation criteria. However, the proposal suffers from extreme brevity and lacks specific architectural, operational, and financial details—particularly regarding concrete SLA commitments, exact alert configuration mechanisms, and a fixed pricing model. Because all evaluated criteria are set to a medium priority (Score 3), the proposal is not rejected outright for failing must-have deal-breakers, but it requires rigorous clarification before final award.
strengths: Explicitly confirms direct integration with the existing PostgreSQL database without requiring a database migration.
Acknowledges all core functional scope elements including real-time dashboards, alerts, RBAC, and a phased onboarding plan.
Pricing range (€70,000 to €110,000) fits comfortably within the customer's stated budget of €80,000–€120,000.
weaknesses_and_gaps: Extremely vague timeline ('Begin with discovery, follow with pilot, and complete rollout in due time') failing to commit to the 3-month pilot and 6-month full rollout milestones.
Fails to provide firm pricing, offering only a conditional range dependent on a future discovery phase.
Omits concrete details regarding SLA response times, support maintenance terms, and documentation of technical assumptions or risks.

scorecard.evaluation_notes: Mentioned conceptually in the technical solution, but lacks architectural specifics regarding tech stack, refresh rates, or web accessibility.

scorecard.requirement_title: Data Migration and Multi-Site Onboarding Plan
scorecard.evaluation_notes: Mentions a detailed phased migration and onboarding plan, but provides zero scheduling or operational detail.

scorecard.requirement_title: Post-Go-Live Support and Service Level Agreements (SLAs)
scorecard.evaluation_notes: Completely absent from the submitted proposal; no mention of support terms, helpdesk hours, or response time SLAs.

scorecard.requirement_title: Documentation of Assumptions, Limitations, and Risks
scorecard.evaluation_notes: No technical assumptions, platform limitations, or operational risk assessments were documented in the response.
